excluded: #timePlayhead inherits text color but contains no text. Its 1.30 text ratio was an invalid algorithmic candidate, not an actual contrast failure. The actual marker/background non-text pair is tested separately.
disabled: Disabled save is visually differentiated; no minimum text contrast claim for disabled exception.
decorative: Panel divider is not tested as essential component boundary.
hover: #212121 is a sampled transition frame, not claimed as the final token value.
